What to Do & Core Tips: Walk down Heritage Street. Shorter lines inside the shrine. View the peaceful dawn light reflecting off the Sarovar.
Sit cross-legged on the floor and share a simple, delicious traditional meal of dal, roti, and hot kheer.
Walk 3 minutes from the temple gates. View the historic bullet-ridden walls, Martyrs' Well, and the eternal flame.
Order hot, butter-drenched tandoori Aloo-Paneer Kulchas crushed by hand, served with spicy chole and a glass of Lassi.
Head back to your hotel to freshen up, rest your legs, and charge your devices for the long afternoon road trip stretch.
Walk down to the historic Town Hall on Heritage Street. Spend an hour browsing moving artifacts, diaries, and migration stories.
Drive 30 km west towards the Pakistan border. Enjoy broad highways lined with open green Punjabi fields.
Park the vehicle. STRICT RULE: Leave all bags, purses, and power banks locked in the car trunk. Carry only phones, wallets, and keys.
Take seats in the open amphitheater. Enjoy patriotic music and watch the high-kicking flag-lowering drill by BSF Jawans.
Drive back east to the city center. Enjoy the winter twilight sky as the sun sets completely by 05:30 PM. Park the car at the hotel.
